description: Use when an agent needs a reliable plain-text summary of a topic. Returns the Wikipedia summary and lead section for a page title in any language, with the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence, the article URL and the authors link. Cached 24 hours. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

title.description: the article title, e.g. Solana (blockchain platform)

name: get_wiki

data.description: the get_wiki payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_wiki

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Wikipedia summary
